closest_works.shared_claim: Partial similarity response and holism are already explicitly discussed; the proposal does not claim these ideas.
closest_works.difference: Non-subtractive finite countermodel allowing wholly transformed lossy memories; distinguishes no-false-difference from no-erased-difference conditions and positive/null evidence without atomic phenomenal parts.

closest_works.shared_claim: Reported mental contrasts need not establish phenomenal contrasts.
closest_works.difference: Leaves their identification burden intact; defeats a different claimed logical obstruction from memory non-reconstruction.

closest_works.citation: Chudnoff, Phenomenal Contrast Arguments for Cognitive Phenomenology
closest_works.shared_claim: Differences alone do not establish irreducible cognitive phenomenology.
closest_works.difference: No claim to establish irreducibility; investigates prior evidence step and asymmetric loss under memory transformation.

limitations: Bounded web search and selected primary excerpts, not full literature coverage; no empirical validation of phenomenal memory mapping.
